preconditions.description: The number of favourite integers t is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= 10**18 for xi in x)
preconditions.description: Each favourite integer xi is between 1 and 10^18.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of favourite integers t.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((xi % 2 == 1 and output[i] == 'YES') or (xi % 2 == 0 and output[i] == 'NO') for i, xi in enumerate(x))
postconditions.description: If xi is odd, the output is 'YES'; if xi is even, the output is 'NO'.
